pack.title: Neighborhood group chat
pack.description: Correct a public accusation without starting a pile-on.

scenarios.setting: A neighborhood chat names your home as responsible for a mess you did not leave.
scenarios.jab: Number twelve left all these boxes out again.
scenarios.goal: Correct a public accusation without starting a pile-on.

replies.line: Those aren't our boxes. Please check before naming a household.
replies.why: It corrects the attribution and asks for a fairer process.
replies.delivery: Write one calm correction; do not post personal details or speculate about another neighbor.

replies.line: Not our boxes. Please correct the post.
replies.why: It asks for a concrete correction without counteraccusing another household.
replies.delivery: Write one calm correction; do not post personal details or speculate about another neighbor.

replies.line: I think there's been a mix-up; those boxes aren't ours, so could you update the post?
replies.why: It offers a face-saving explanation while requesting the correction.
replies.delivery: Write one calm correction; do not post personal details or speculate about another neighbor.

replies.line: Our boxes have an alibi; these aren't ours.
replies.why: A light joke corrects the record without naming another suspect.
replies.delivery: Write one calm correction; do not post personal details or speculate about another neighbor.

followUp.line: Agreed; let's find out who rather than guessing publicly.
followUp.why: It redirects the thread from speculation to verification.
followUp.delivery: Write one calm correction; do not post personal details or speculate about another neighbor.
